university-registration: We are active at many universities. We are registered at:
title: Begin your next chapter on the right path.
title-2: Build meaningful relationships in a Bible-centered community. Get to know Christ in your everyday life and grow in faith together with others.
bible-study-meeting-description-1: Grow by planting deep, personal roots in the Lord and develop good basic spiritual habits, such as daily Bible reading.
bible-study-meeting-description-2: Join our Bible study group on the SGGW and UW campuses. Small-group study will help you grow in your love for God's Word and in your relationship with Him.
bible-study-meeting-description-3: We meet throughout the week on campus.
student-meeting-description-1: We were never meant to follow Christ alone.
student-meeting-description-2: Build meaningful relationships that will last beyond college and join others in this race. Together, we learn to pursue Christ.
home-meeting-description-2: Join a home group and share a weekly meal and fellowship with students and CNU alumni near your university.
home-meeting-description-4: Weekly meetings will equip you with the living truth of the Bible. Together we discover how it speaks into our lives and guides us.
home-meeting-description-5: Join our weekly Bible study series
home-meeting-description-7: The food in the cafeteria may be delicious, but nothing compares to a home-cooked meal! Each week, CNU alumni open their homes to students for dinner, singing, and fellowship. They welcome us with open hearts—and open refrigerators—and we’re incredibly grateful for their care, encouragement, and support. Our students often say that the love and care they experienced in their home groups had a profound impact on their lives, both during their university years and long after graduation.
together-time-description-2: Join a home group and share a weekly meal and fellowship with students and alumni near your campus.
about-us-description-1: Christians on Campus is a registered student organization whose purpose is to bring Christ closer to students and bring students closer to Christ.
about-us-description-2: Although we come from different places and backgrounds, we gather around what unites us—our common faith in Christ.
about-us-description-3: For more than 10 years, we have been serving students with truth and life. Through Bible study meetings, weekly gatherings, and a vibrant student community, we want to help students seeking God find Him in a real and living way.
about-us-description-4: It can be summed up in one sentence: Follow Christ together. Our goal is to provide students with a genuine community of believers where they can follow Christ, be rooted in the truth of God's Word, and be equipped for life according to God's purpose.
